basic_info.description: REDUCED PRICE! Perched atop Corona Heights with sweeping views over Eureka Valley, this modern multi-level condo offers breathtaking vistas of the City and bay. Watch stunning SF sunrises from the great room, primary suite, or guest bedroom. The main level features a spacious living/dining area with vaulted ceilings, a stately fireplace, and a view deck (leading to a charming garden below) plus a step-up kitchen - perfect for entertaining. A guest bedroom with walk-in closet, full bath, and large hall storage closet completes this level. Upstairs, the well-appointed primary suite boasts two generous closets, office nook and a marble en-suite bath. Interior access leads to 1-car garage parking, storage, and laundry. Low HOA dues. Enjoy the panoramic beauty of Corona Heights and Twin Peaks, or head to Eureka Valley's Castro and Upper Market neighborhoods for fantastic dining options, specialty shops and boutiques and vibrant nightlife. From the Castro, take the MUNI underground to quickly get downtown or connect with BART for regional transportation. Walk score: 89; Transit score: 75.
